title: Treasury Returns and Reissues of Disability Compensation Payments; Payments After a Veteran's Death
content:
**Reissue after a return.** A Disability Compensation payment returned for a closed or invalid account or as an undeliverable check is reissued only after the payment account or mailing address on the award has been updated, and each returned payment is reissued only once. Whether a returned payment has already been reissued is read from the award's payment history: a returned payment that already has a reissue pointing to it is not reissued again.

**Death of the veteran.** When the veteran dies:

- the award terminates effective the last day of the month of death;
- the payment for the month of death is released to the surviving spouse;
- every payment issued for an entitlement month after the month of death is reclaimed from the bank as a returned payment with the reason "payee deceased", and is never reissued.

**Effect on the delivered total.** Monthly payments, retroactive releases and reissues add to the net Disability Compensation delivered to the veteran; payments the Treasury returns to VA take away from it.

**Cases (hypothetical)**

| Situation | Reissue? |
|---|---|
| Payment returned for a closed account; the award still shows the closed account | Not until the payment account on the award has been updated |
| Payment returned for a closed account; the account on the award has since been updated; no earlier reissue | Yes, once |
| Same returned payment, already reissued once | No |
| Payment for a month after the month of death, reclaimed as payee deceased | Never |

**Death illustration (hypothetical).** A veteran dies on 18 May. The award terminates effective 31 May; the payment for May is released to the surviving spouse; a payment already issued for June is reclaimed as a returned payment with the reason "payee deceased" and is not reissued.
